summary.text: Andrew Rockhold is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 4A in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
A business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include ending fraud and wasteful government spending and eliminating property taxes.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Rockhold said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was raised in mid-Missouri and holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from College of the Ozarks.
He said he is married and has six children, and that his family owns Good News Auto Sales, sells real estate, and that he works part time for a major airline out of Fargo.
Rockhold listed fraud and wasted money, property taxes and personal responsibility as his campaign messages.
He wrote that he believes life begins at conception and should be protected, and named life, taxes, fraud and transportation as his policy interests.
